name: @kickside/skills-ui
title: KickSide Skills
description: Skills control page web component for kickside/skills, over the native skills CRUD/share API.

wippy.description: Ships two web components from one package. kickside-skills (index.js, the browser entry) is the full Skills management surface: it lists the actor's skills from GET /api/v1/skills with client-side search and supports create, refine, share and delete, plus editing a skill's bundled files and browsing/previewing its version history. It takes no props, talks to the backend through the @wippy-fe/proxy authenticated api client and host helpers (host.toast/host.confirm), and declares no custom events of its own. kickside-skill-picker (picker.js, registered separately as the skill_picker_view view.component) is the Skills trait config editor the agent editor mounts by tag: it receives the trait context via the config prop ({ skill_ids: string[] } or a bare id array) and emits config-changed with { skill_ids } whenever the pinned skill set changes — that is the config-changed event described in the events schema below.

config-changed.description: Emitted by the kickside-skill-picker element (Skills trait config) when the pinned skill set changes.
